text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown makes preparations for the 
Yayoi Sho. Many of the Umamusume running 
in the same race are graded race winners.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A fierce race is inevitable. Faced with 
this adversity, Satono Crown wears a 
smile. Knowing she's not one to lose here.
